entities.summary: Steven Da Costa (b. 1997-01-23, Mont-Saint-Martin) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mont-Saint-Martin and France. Known in the fields of france, architects & designers, europe.
